thread:
Tobin Reed: hey y'all! i'm Tobin (he/they) — joined today as Infra Eng. i'm an origami nerd, paper-plane obsessive, and bring a slightly embarrassing thermos of miso to most lunches. WFH Mon/Tue, in the SF office on Thursdays. happy to trade paper-plane tips or tiny synth patches. here's a tiny desk photo + plane: https://imgur.com/xyz123 :wave:

Emily Park: welcome Tobin!! :tada: adding you to the new-hires lunch list now. origami + paper-plane club is approved by people ops :ok_hand:

Jorge Luna: welcome! paper-plane contest stakes: loser buys bagels. you're on :) :bagel:

Samira Patel: omg i love this. will there be categories? longest glide, trick flight, and most dramatic crash? :airplane: :laughing:

Tobin Reed: @Samira @Jorge longest glide and most dramatic crash for sure. also small prize: vintage cassette or a mysterious sticker pack. desk is 3C near the big windows if anyone wants to drop by — i'll bring spare paper and a little folding kit.

welcome-bot: 🎉 Tobin Reed added to #new-hires. Welcome kit pickup: Reception (8am–6pm).

Emily Park: tiny note: People Ops (me) will DM you about badge setup and commuter parking. also welcome kit contains a plant starter (no promises) :seedling:

Alex: welcome Tobin! if you're into synths i have a tiny modular that barely works but sounds adorable. also trade offer: i'll bring bagels if you teach me a flight that actually glides further than 3 meters. :synth:

Jorge Luna: agreed, bagels as a currency. also addition: mandatory terrible pun during onboarding required.

Samira Patel: poll time — miso thermos or french press for team coffee fund? vote with emoji. :coffee: = french press, :bowl_with_spoon: = miso (i'm kidding but also not)

Tobin Reed: thanks everyone — excited to be here. two promises: i'll never steal your desk plants intentionally, and i'll try to make at least one paper airplane that stays airborne. see you Thursday! :airplane: :seedling:
